text: Emit a shell-safe, copy-pastable repro argv from each existing failing unittest assertion so the parent reruns the same command instead of reconstructing a probe.
rationale: Inversion: ambiguous hand-written probes guarantee syntax repair; emitted argv removes that reconstruction.

text: Make boundary fixtures carry a named byte budget and expected retained length, letting cap and UTF-8 assertions consume the same fixture metadata.
rationale: Inversion: separate literal limits guarantee cap-versus-508 disputes; one fixture-owned budget aligns the boundary.

text: Have packaging/build_plugin.py report the exact artifact path, slice window, raw exit, and invocation whenever an existing verification command fails.
rationale: Inversion: reconstructing paths and exits guarantees parent reruns; failure output keeps the original command and evidence together.

text: Replace ad-hoc diagnostic probes with an optional test-local explanation branch that prints raw inputs and exits without changing the normal command.
rationale: Inversion: every extra shell probe guarantees another quoting failure; a test-owned explanation path keeps diagnosis beside the assertion.

text: Canonicalize git-status output once at the verification boundary and include the exact retained slice in the existing assertion message.
rationale: Inversion: worker and parent slicing independently guarantees disagreement; one boundary-visible slice removes duplicate interpretation.

text: Attach an ephemeral failure capsule to existing test output containing target, argv, limit, observed bytes, and exit code, without creating a ledger.
rationale: Inversion: missing context guarantees the parent repeats the investigation; a compact capsule makes one raw rerun sufficient.
